title: Source
description: One registration of an immutable raw archive (housamkak v3 §6.1) — a row of llm-wiki/states/sources.jsonl. The ledger is append-only: re-registering a source (for example to override its authority) appends a new row with the same source_id, and the latest row wins on replay. hash proves immutability; a mismatch at register time means the archive was edited in place, which the raw layer forbids.

source_id.description: src_ + first 12 hex of sha256(repo-relative path). Content-derived, so parallel sessions never collide.

type.description: Document kind in the author's words — gist, spec, adr, transcript, paper, clipping.

channel.description: The raw folder the archive lives in; sets the default source_authority.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the archive — the same string a page's sources[].resource carries. Admits the private segment's raw/ alongside the shared one.

url.description: The archive's source: frontmatter value when it was fetched from the web.

created_at.description: The source's own date: the archive's published/last_modified/date/created frontmatter, else register --created-at; null when unknown. Recency at observation time counts from it.

source_authority.description: How trusted this source is, 0–1. Defaults per channel; a human may override at register time.

authority_set_by.description: Present when source_authority is a human override rather than the channel default.

sensitivity.description: The note's vocabulary. This layer is fully tracked: the shared segment registers only public and internal, the private segment also accepts private, and secret is refused in both.

run_id.description: The run that appended this row (spec.md `### Ledger rows`) — run_ + 12 hex of sha256(actor · verb · timestamp · the input hashes · views_before), the same id stamped on the row's states/audit_log.jsonl entry. Optional: absent on every row from Phases 1–5, present on every row Phase 6 on appends.
